lessons.title: 科研交流与博后面试
lessons.description: 60 句原创教学表达：1–20 研究介绍，21–40 博后面试，41–60 会议交流。练习说明研究问题、表达个人贡献、回应现场追问；第一人称内容请按真实经历修改。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: My research interests lie at the intersection of ecology and bioinformatics.
sentences.zh: 我的研究兴趣位于生态学与生物信息学的交叉领域。
sentences.note: lie at the intersection of 用于介绍两个领域交叉处的研究定位；interests 作复数主语。
sentences.question: Which ecological question would benefit most from your computational skills?

chunks.zh: 生态学与生物信息学的

sentences.en: I am interested in how microbial communities respond to environmental change.
sentences.zh: 我关注微生物群落如何响应环境变化。
sentences.note: be interested in 后可接 how 引导的从句；respond to 表示对某种变化作出响应。
sentences.question: Which environmental change is central to your current research?

sentences.en: My broader goal is to connect community patterns with ecological processes.
sentences.zh: 我更长远的目标是把群落格局与生态过程联系起来。
sentences.note: goal is to 后用动词原形陈述目标；connect A with B 清楚标出希望建立联系的两方面。
sentences.question: Which ecological process could explain a pattern in your data?

sentences.en: The starting point is a biological question rather than a particular software package.
sentences.zh: 研究的出发点是生物学问题，而非某个特定的软件包。
sentences.note: rather than 在这里对比两个名词短语，适合解释研究设计的优先顺序。
sentences.question: How would you state your biological question without naming any software?

chunks.en: rather than a particular software package

sentences.en: I would first define the comparison before choosing an analysis method.
sentences.zh: 我会先明确要进行什么比较，再选择分析方法。
sentences.note: would 描述拟采用的做法；before 后接动名词 choosing，说明分析决策的顺序。
sentences.question: Which comparison would best address your main hypothesis?

sentences.en: The project could focus on differences between sites with contrasting soil properties.
sentences.zh: 这个项目可以聚焦于土壤性质不同的地点之间的差异。
sentences.note: could focus on 表达可讨论的选题；with contrasting soil properties 修饰 sites。
sentences.question: Which soil property would guide your choice of comparison sites?

sentences.en: A clear sampling strategy would help align the data with the research question.
sentences.zh: 清晰的采样策略将有助于使数据与研究问题相匹配。
sentences.note: help 后可直接接动词原形；align A with B 表示使 A 与 B 对应或一致。
sentences.question: What sampling decision would most affect your ability to answer the question?

sentences.en: I would document sample metadata before interpreting differences in microbial composition.
sentences.zh: 我会先记录样本元数据，再解读微生物组成上的差异。
sentences.note: before interpreting 将记录元数据置于解释结果之前；composition 指群落由哪些成员构成。
sentences.question: Which metadata fields would be essential for your study?

sentences.en: My analysis plan would include quality checks at each major processing step.
sentences.zh: 我的分析计划将在每个主要处理步骤中安排质量检查。
sentences.note: would include 说明计划中的组成部分；at each 强调逐个步骤而非只在流程结尾检查。
sentences.question: Where would you place the most important quality check in your workflow?

chunks.zh: 在每个主要处理步骤中

sentences.en: I would keep the analysis code separate from the original data files.
sentences.zh: 我会将分析代码与原始数据文件分开保存。
sentences.note: keep A separate from B 用于说明文件组织方式；separate 在这里作形容词，读音以 /ət/ 结尾。
sentences.question: How would another researcher locate the code and data for your project?

sentences.en: The main figure should make the central comparison easy to understand at a glance.
sentences.zh: 主要结果图应让人一眼就能理解核心比较。
sentences.note: make + 宾语 + 形容词描述呈现效果；at a glance 表示快速看一眼就能获得信息。
sentences.question: What single comparison should a reader notice first in your main figure?

sentences.en: I would explain the main finding before discussing the technical details.
sentences.zh: 我会先解释主要发现，再讨论技术细节。
sentences.note: before discussing 帮助安排报告顺序；finding 指研究发现，使用时应替换为已有证据支持的具体结果。
sentences.question: How would you summarize one of your actual findings in a single sentence?

sentences.en: A useful explanation should link the observed pattern to the original question.
sentences.zh: 有用的解释应将观察到的格局与最初的研究问题联系起来。
sentences.note: link A to B 把结果与问题对应起来；observed 强调这是数据中观察到的现象。
sentences.question: How does one pattern in your data address your original question?

sentences.en: I would distinguish statistical uncertainty from limitations in the study design.
sentences.zh: 我会区分统计不确定性与研究设计本身的局限。
sentences.note: distinguish A from B 用来区分两类问题；uncertainty 不可数，不加不定冠词。
sentences.question: Which uncertainty could more data reduce, and which requires a different study design?

sentences.en: An association would motivate further investigation without establishing a causal mechanism.
sentences.zh: 关联可以推动进一步研究，但并不能确立因果机制。
sentences.note: without 后接 establishing，限定关联能够支持的结论；would 在这里表示假设情形。
sentences.question: What additional evidence would help you investigate a proposed mechanism?

sentences.en: The next step would depend on which alternative explanations remain plausible.
sentences.zh: 下一步将取决于哪些其他解释仍然合理。
sentences.note: depend on 后接 which 引导的从句；remain plausible 表示某种解释尚不能被现有证据排除。
sentences.question: Which alternative explanation would you examine before extending the project?

sentences.en: I hope to develop stronger skills in connecting computational results with biological reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我希望提升将计算结果与生物学推理联系起来的能力。
sentences.note: hope to 表达发展目标；skills in 后接动名词，说明希望加强的具体能力。
sentences.question: Which biological interpretation has challenged you most in your research?

sentences.en: Working with ecologists could help me refine the biological interpretation of these patterns.
sentences.zh: 与生态学家合作可以帮助我完善对这些格局的生物学解释。
sentences.note: 动名词短语 Working with ecologists 作主语；refine 表示在已有理解上进一步完善。
sentences.question: What question would you bring to a collaborator with ecological expertise?

sentences.en: For a general audience I would explain the question before introducing specialized terms.
sentences.zh: 面向非专业听众时，我会先说明研究问题，再介绍专业术语。
sentences.note: 句首 For a general audience 指定听众；specialized terms 表示某一领域的专业术语。
sentences.question: How would you describe your project to a friend outside biology?

sentences.en: I would end my introduction with one question that invites further discussion.
sentences.zh: 我会在介绍的结尾提出一个问题，邀请对方进一步讨论。
sentences.note: end A with B 表示用 B 收尾；that invites further discussion 修饰 question。
sentences.question: Which question could connect your research interests with those of a potential host lab?

chunks.zh: 能够引出进一步讨论的

sentences.en: I hope to connect computational methods with meaningful biological questions.
sentences.zh: 我希望将计算方法与有意义的生物学问题联系起来。
sentences.note: hope to 后接动词原形说明目标；connect A with B 表达两个方向的结合。
sentences.question: Which biological question would motivate your next research project?

chunks.zh: 与有意义的生物学问题

sentences.en: This position could help me develop a clearer independent research direction.
sentences.zh: 这个岗位可以帮助我形成更清晰的独立研究方向。
sentences.note: could help me develop 表达岗位可能带来的成长；clearer 比较的是方向的清晰程度。
sentences.question: What independent research direction would you like to develop?

chunks.zh: 更清晰的独立研究方向

sentences.en: I would like to understand how your team chooses research priorities.
sentences.zh: 我想了解你们团队如何确定研究优先事项。
sentences.note: would like to 比 want to 更适合礼貌提问；how 从句询问决策方式。
sentences.question: How would you ask about the team’s current priorities?

chunks.en: how your team chooses research priorities
chunks.zh: 团队如何确定研究优先事项

sentences.en: My ideal project would combine method development with close scientific collaboration.
sentences.zh: 我理想中的项目会将分析方法开发与密切的科研合作结合起来。
sentences.note: would 描述理想情境；combine A with B 表达希望同时具备的两个要素。
sentences.question: What balance of methods development and collaboration would suit you?

sentences.en: I could contribute by making complex analyses easier to explain.
sentences.zh: 我可以通过让复杂分析更易理解，为团队作出贡献。
sentences.note: contribute by 后接动名词说明贡献方式；make something easier to explain 表达沟通价值。
sentences.question: Which part of a complex analysis would you explain first?

sentences.en: I would first clarify the question before suggesting an analytical approach.
sentences.zh: 我会先澄清问题，再提出分析方案。
sentences.note: first 与 before 说明工作顺序；suggest an approach 表示提出可讨论的方案。
sentences.question: What would you clarify before starting an unfamiliar analysis?

sentences.en: A concrete example would show how I approach unfamiliar problems.
sentences.zh: 一个具体案例可以展示我如何处理不熟悉的问题。
sentences.note: show how 引出解决问题的方式；concrete example 应替换为本人真实且可说明的经历。
sentences.question: Which real example best illustrates your approach to unfamiliar problems?

chunks.zh: 我如何处理不熟悉的问题

sentences.en: I prefer to explain my contribution separately from the team’s broader work.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于分别说明自己的贡献和团队整体的工作。
sentences.note: prefer to 表达个人偏好；separately from 明确区分本人职责与团队成果。
sentences.question: How would you describe your own contribution to a collaborative project?

chunks.en: separately from the team’s broader work
chunks.zh: 与团队整体工作分别说明

sentences.en: When methods disagree, I would examine their assumptions before choosing between them.
sentences.zh: 方法结果不一致时，我会先检查各自的假设，再作选择。
sentences.note: When 引出情境；before choosing between them 表明选择前的判断依据。
sentences.question: What could explain disagreement between two reasonable methods?

sentences.en: When discussing a failed attempt, I would explain the lessons and subsequent changes.
sentences.zh: 讨论一次未成功的尝试时，我会说明得到的经验和后续改进。
sentences.note: When discussing 引出讨论情境；the lessons and subsequent changes 把反思与后续行动一起说明。
sentences.question: What did a real setback change about your way of working?

chunks.zh: 讨论一次未成功的尝试时
得到的经验和后续改进

sentences.en: An honest answer should distinguish current skills from areas requiring further training.
sentences.zh: 诚实的回答应区分已有技能与仍需进一步训练的领域。
sentences.note: distinguish A from B 用于区分能力现状；requiring further training 修饰 areas。
sentences.question: Which skill would you most like to develop during a postdoc?

chunks.zh: 与仍需进一步训练的领域

sentences.en: For an unfamiliar tool, I would begin with documentation and small examples.
sentences.zh: 面对不熟悉的工具，我会从文档和小型示例入手。
sentences.note: For 引出讨论对象；begin with 指明起点，适合介绍学习方法。
sentences.question: How would you demonstrate that you can learn a new tool?

chunks.zh: 从文档和小型示例入手

sentences.en: Regular discussions would help align my work with the team’s goals.
sentences.zh: 定期讨论有助于使我的工作与团队目标保持一致。
sentences.note: help align A with B 表达协调；regular 指定期进行，不指定固定频率。
sentences.question: What kind of discussion schedule helps you work effectively?

sentences.en: I would express disagreement by explaining the evidence behind my concern.
sentences.zh: 我会通过说明担忧背后的证据，表达不同意见。
sentences.note: by explaining 表达提出分歧的方式；the evidence behind 强调意见需要依据。
sentences.question: How would you disagree constructively with a senior collaborator?

sentences.en: Clear expectations would help me manage several projects without losing focus.
sentences.zh: 清晰的预期有助于我管理多个项目，同时保持专注。
sentences.note: help someone manage 表达支持作用；without losing focus 说明同时需要维持的状态。
sentences.question: How would you prioritize competing project deadlines?

sentences.en: Could you describe how supervision changes as a researcher gains independence?
sentences.zh: 您能介绍一下，随着研究者逐渐独立，指导方式会如何变化吗？
sentences.note: Could you describe 是礼貌的开放式提问；as 引出随发展而变化的过程。
sentences.question: What would you want to know about supervision in a new lab?

sentences.en: What opportunities would there be to develop and lead a new project?
sentences.zh: 这里会有哪些机会，让我开发并主导一个新项目？
sentences.note: What opportunities would there be 使用 there be 的疑问形式；to develop and lead 说明机会的内容。
sentences.question: How would you ask about opportunities to lead a project?

sentences.en: I would appreciate hearing how the team supports professional development.
sentences.zh: 我想了解团队如何支持成员的职业发展。
sentences.note: would appreciate hearing 是礼貌表达；appreciate 后接动名词 hearing。
sentences.question: Which professional development opportunity would matter most to you?

chunks.en: how the team supports professional development
chunks.zh: 团队如何支持职业发展

sentences.en: How do collaborators usually agree on responsibilities at the start?
sentences.zh: 合作开始时，参与者通常如何商定各自的职责？
sentences.note: agree on 表示就某事达成一致；at the start 明确希望在开始阶段沟通。
sentences.question: What responsibilities would you clarify before joining a shared project?

sentences.en: My next step would be to identify where our research interests overlap.
sentences.zh: 我的下一步会是明确双方研究兴趣的交集。
sentences.note: My next step would be to 用于提出具体后续行动；where 从句表达交集所在。
sentences.question: How would you close an interview with a useful next step?

chunks.zh: 双方研究兴趣在哪里交汇

sentences.en: I would appreciate a little clarification about your comparison group.
sentences.zh: 我希望您能进一步说明一下比较组的情况。
sentences.note: would appreciate 是礼貌提出请求的结构；about 后接需要澄清的具体内容。
sentences.question: Ask a presenter to clarify how the comparison group was selected.

sentences.en: I understand your question as a concern about the sampling strategy.
sentences.zh: 我理解您的问题是在关注采样策略。
sentences.note: understand A as B 用于复述对问题的理解，便于对方及时纠正。
sentences.question: Restate a difficult audience question before answering it.

sentences.en: The horizontal axis shows the variable used to compare these observations.
sentences.zh: 横坐标轴展示了用于比较这些观测值的变量。
sentences.note: used to compare 是过去分词短语，修饰 variable；正式答问时补充变量名和单位。
sentences.question: Explain the horizontal axis of a figure from your project.

chunks.zh: 用于比较这些观测值的

sentences.en: Let me explain the color scale before discussing the broader pattern.
sentences.zh: 我先解释色标，再讨论整体模式。
sentences.note: Let me explain 是简洁的引导语；before discussing 明确讲图顺序。
sentences.question: Introduce a color scale to someone unfamiliar with your data.

sentences.en: I would separate your question into design and interpretation.
sentences.zh: 我会把您的问题分为研究设计和结果解释两部分讨论。
sentences.note: separate...into... 将复杂问题拆成可回答的部分；would 使回应更柔和。
sentences.question: Divide a question with several parts into a clear response structure.

sentences.en: That is a useful distinction between measurement uncertainty and biological variation.
sentences.zh: 这一区分很有帮助，它区分了测量不确定性与生物变异。
sentences.note: a distinction between A and B 指对两个概念的区分；that 承接对方刚提出的观点。
sentences.question: Explain the difference between measurement uncertainty and biological variation.

chunks.en: between measurement uncertainty and biological variation.
chunks.zh: 在测量不确定性与生物变异之间

sentences.en: I agree with the concern but would interpret the evidence more cautiously.
sentences.zh: 我认同这一关切，但会更谨慎地解释这些证据。
sentences.note: agree with 先回应对方的具体观点；but would 后接自己的判断方式。
sentences.question: Respond politely when you share a concern but differ on its interpretation.

sentences.en: An alternative explanation would involve differences in the sampled environments.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能的解释是采样环境存在差异。
sentences.note: An alternative explanation 引入替代解释；would involve 保留假设性。
sentences.question: Offer an alternative explanation without dismissing the speaker’s interpretation.

sentences.en: The evidence would be stronger if the comparison included an independent dataset.
sentences.zh: 如果比较纳入一个独立数据集，证据会更有力。
sentences.note: would...if...included 构成假设条件句，用于提出建设性建议。
sentences.question: Suggest one feasible way to strengthen the evidence in a study.

sentences.en: My suggestion is to examine the assumption most relevant to this conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我的建议是考察与这个结论最相关的假设。
sentences.note: My suggestion is to... 用不定式明确建议采取的动作；most relevant 指出优先顺序。
sentences.question: Which assumption would you recommend checking first, and why?

sentences.en: I would need to check the analysis before giving you a precise answer.
sentences.zh: 我需要先核查分析，才能给您准确回答。
sentences.note: would need to check 说明需要核实的步骤；before giving 避免临场猜测。
sentences.question: How would you respond when the answer depends on an unchecked detail?

sentences.en: That question goes beyond the conditions covered by the current study.
sentences.zh: 那个问题超出了当前研究涵盖的条件。
sentences.note: go beyond 指范围超出；covered by 为过去分词定语，具体限定研究条件。
sentences.question: Explain which aspect of an audience question falls outside your study.

sentences.en: A useful next step would be to test that idea in another setting.
sentences.zh: 有价值的下一步是在另一种情境中检验那个想法。
sentences.note: would be to... 把建议转化为明确行动；another setting 可指地点、人群或研究条件。
sentences.question: Propose a new setting that would meaningfully test the same idea.

sentences.en: For this audience, I would start with the biological question and then introduce the model.
sentences.zh: 面向在场听众，我会先介绍生物学问题，再引入模型。
sentences.note: start with...and then... 清楚安排讲解顺序；For this audience 用于说明信息层次的选择。
sentences.question: How would you explain your analysis to researchers outside your field?

sentences.en: The technical detail matters because it affects which comparisons are valid.
sentences.zh: 这项技术细节很重要，因为它影响哪些比较是有效的。
sentences.note: matters because 将技术细节与推断后果相连；which comparisons are valid 是宾语从句。
sentences.question: Choose one technical detail and explain why a general audience should care.

sentences.en: Let me return to the specific comparison that addresses your question.
sentences.zh: 让我回到能够回应您问题的那项具体比较。
sentences.note: return to 用于把讨论拉回相关证据；that addresses...说明选择该比较的理由。
sentences.question: Bring a discussion back to the evidence most relevant to the question.

sentences.en: Your suggestion could help distinguish between competing interpretations of the same pattern.
sentences.zh: 您的建议可能有助于区分对同一模式的不同解释。
sentences.note: could help 表达建议的潜在价值；competing interpretations 指都需要评估的备选解释。
sentences.question: Explain how a colleague’s suggestion could resolve an uncertainty.

sentences.en: I would welcome your thoughts on the most informative follow-up comparison.
sentences.zh: 我很希望听听您认为哪项后续比较最有信息价值。
sentences.note: would welcome your thoughts on... 是邀请具体反馈的表达；informative 强调比较能提供什么信息。
sentences.question: Invite a discussant to suggest the most informative next comparison.

chunks.en: on the most informative follow-up comparison.
chunks.zh: 关于最有信息价值的后续比较

vocabulary.meaning: 有信息价值的；有启发性的

sentences.en: We can discuss the implementation details after the session if more time is needed.
sentences.zh: 如果需要更多时间，我们可以在会议环节结束后讨论实施细节。
sentences.note: after the session 提供继续讨论的具体时机；if...needed 说明何时采用该安排。
sentences.question: How would you continue a detailed discussion when question time is limited?

sentences.en: My brief answer is that the interpretation depends on the comparison being made.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，这一解释取决于所进行的比较。
sentences.note: My brief answer is that... 用于先给结论；being made 后置修饰 comparison。
sentences.question: Give a short answer first, then name the condition that changes it.

lessons.title: 生信分析与可复现研究
lessons.description: 60 句原创教学表达：1–20 生信分析流程，21–40 模型验证，41–60 可复现研究。练习讲清质量控制、数据划分、模型评价及分析记录；方法选择需结合实际研究设计。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: Sample identifiers must remain consistent across every analysis table.
sentences.zh: 各分析表中的样本标识必须保持一致。
sentences.note: must remain 后接形容词 consistent，强调需要持续满足的条件；across 表示跨表。
sentences.question: How do you check that sample identifiers match?

sentences.en: I check the metadata before choosing an appropriate comparison.
sentences.zh: 我会先检查元数据，再选择合适的比较方式。
sentences.note: before choosing 用动名词表达步骤顺序；appropriate 强调比较方式要符合数据设计。
sentences.question: Which metadata fields guide your choice of comparison?

chunks.zh: 在选择合适比较方式之前

sentences.en: Missing labels can prevent us from interpreting a sample correctly.
sentences.zh: 缺失的标签可能使我们无法正确解读一个样本。
sentences.note: prevent someone from doing 表示阻止某人做某事；can 保留可能性。
sentences.question: What would you do if a sample label were missing?

sentences.en: Quality thresholds should reflect the data type and research question.
sentences.zh: 质量阈值应与数据类型和研究问题相匹配。
sentences.note: should reflect 用于解释决策原则；并列名词说明阈值取决于两个因素。
sentences.question: How would you justify your quality thresholds?

sentences.en: We document excluded samples and explain each exclusion clearly.
sentences.zh: 我们记录被排除的样本，并清楚解释每次排除的原因。
sentences.note: document 和 explain 是共用主语的并列谓语；excluded 是过去分词，修饰 samples。
sentences.question: How will you communicate sample exclusions to collaborators?

sentences.en: Unexpected clustering may reflect technical variation rather than biology.
sentences.zh: 异常的聚类现象可能反映技术变异，而非生物学差异。
sentences.note: may reflect 提出待核查的解释；rather than 比较两种可能来源，不能把它当作已有结论。
sentences.question: What checks would help explain an unexpected cluster?

sentences.en: Batch information helps us distinguish technical patterns from biological signals.
sentences.zh: 批次信息有助于我们区分技术模式和生物学信号。
sentences.note: help someone do 与 distinguish A from B 连用；helps 表示提供帮助，不保证完全分离。
sentences.question: Where is batch information recorded in your project?

sentences.en: A balanced design can reduce confounding between groups and batches.
sentences.zh: 平衡的设计可以减少分组与批次之间的混杂。
sentences.note: between A and B 说明混杂涉及的两个变量；can reduce 不表示完全消除。
sentences.question: How could the design reduce group and batch confounding?

sentences.en: Normalization changes the scale on which measurements are compared.
sentences.zh: 归一化会改变测量值进行比较时所使用的尺度。
sentences.note: on which 引导定语从句，修饰 scale；measurements are compared 使用被动语态。
sentences.question: Why is the comparison scale important for your analysis?

sentences.en: The reference database influences which features receive an annotation.
sentences.zh: 参考数据库会影响哪些特征能够获得注释。
sentences.note: which 引出宾语从句，说明受影响的具体对象；an annotation 指一项注释。
sentences.question: How did you choose a reference database?

sentences.en: Unclassified features should remain visible in the summary report.
sentences.zh: 未分类的特征也应在总结报告中保留展示。
sentences.note: remain visible 表示保持可见状态；unclassified 不等于不存在或不重要。
sentences.question: How would you describe unclassified features in a presentation?

sentences.en: Feature filtering can change the set of hypotheses being tested.
sentences.zh: 特征过滤可能改变实际接受检验的假设集合。
sentences.note: being tested 是被动形式的分词短语，修饰 hypotheses；can change 提醒分析集合会变化。
sentences.question: How do you explain the purpose of feature filtering?

sentences.en: Relative abundance describes proportions within a sample, not absolute quantities.
sentences.zh: 相对丰度描述样本内的比例，而不是绝对数量。
sentences.note: within a sample 明确比例的参照范围；not absolute quantities 点明不能直接据此推断绝对数量。
sentences.question: How would you explain relative abundance to a new collaborator?

sentences.en: The analysis unit should match the level of independent sampling.
sentences.zh: 分析单位应与独立采样所对应的层级一致。
sentences.note: match 表示相匹配；the level of 明确需要对齐的是采样层级。
sentences.question: What is the independent sampling unit in your study?

sentences.en: Repeated observations from one participant may require a different model.
sentences.zh: 来自同一参与者的重复观测可能需要采用不同的模型。
sentences.note: from one participant 修饰 observations；may require 保留对具体研究设计的判断空间。
sentences.question: How would repeated observations affect your model choice?

sentences.en: We compare intermediate outputs to locate differences between pipeline versions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过比较中间输出，定位不同流程版本之间的差异。
sentences.note: to locate 是目的状语；intermediate outputs 比笼统的 results 更准确地指流程中间产物。
sentences.question: Which intermediate outputs would you compare first?

sentences.en: A workflow diagram makes dependencies between analysis steps easier to explain.
sentences.zh: 流程图让分析步骤之间的依赖关系更容易说明。
sentences.note: make something easier to do 表示使某事更容易完成；dependencies 指步骤间的前后依赖。
sentences.question: Which dependency is most important in your workflow?

chunks.zh: 分析步骤之间的依赖关系

sentences.en: Sensitivity checks reveal how conclusions depend on reasonable analytical choices.
sentences.zh: 敏感性检查揭示结论如何依赖合理的分析选择。
sentences.note: how 引出宾语从句；depend on 用于说明结论与分析决策之间的关系。
sentences.question: Which analytical choice deserves a sensitivity check?

sentences.en: I summarize the workflow before discussing its strongest assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我先概述分析流程，再讨论其中最关键的假设。
sentences.note: before discussing 表示讲述顺序；assumptions 指方法成立时依赖的前提。
sentences.question: Which assumption would you explain before presenting the results?

chunks.zh: 在讨论其关键假设之前

sentences.en: Each figure should answer a question about the underlying data.
sentences.zh: 每张图都应回答一个与其底层数据有关的问题。
sentences.note: underlying 修饰 data，指图所依据的数据；answer a question 让图的目的更加明确。
sentences.question: What question should your main figure answer?

sentences.en: The test set should remain separate during model development.
sentences.zh: 模型开发期间，测试集应保持独立。
sentences.note: remain separate 表示持续保持分离状态；during model development 说明适用阶段。
sentences.question: When would you first inspect the test set results?

sentences.en: Preprocessing parameters should be learned from the training data only.
sentences.zh: 预处理参数应仅从训练数据中学习得到。
sentences.note: should be learned 使用被动语态；only 限定参数学习的数据来源。
sentences.question: Which preprocessing steps learn parameters from the data?

sentences.en: Information leakage can make validation performance appear unrealistically strong.
sentences.zh: 信息泄漏可能让验证表现显得好得不真实。
sentences.note: make something appear 加形容词，表达某种表象；can 保留具体情境下的可能性。
sentences.question: What is one possible source of leakage in your workflow?

sentences.en: Samples from one individual should stay within the same partition.
sentences.zh: 来自同一个体的样本应保留在同一数据分区内。
sentences.note: from one individual 修饰 samples；within the same partition 表示避免个体信息跨分区泄漏。
sentences.question: How would you split repeated samples from individual participants?

sentences.en: A temporal split can evaluate predictions on later observations.
sentences.zh: 按时间划分可以评估模型对较晚观测的预测表现。
sentences.note: temporal 表示与时间有关；on later observations 说明评估的数据来自较晚时段。
sentences.question: Would a temporal split fit your intended prediction task?

sentences.en: Cross-validation estimates performance under the chosen resampling scheme.
sentences.zh: 交叉验证估计的是所选重采样方案下的模型表现。
sentences.note: under the chosen scheme 明确性能估计依赖的设计；estimates 不表示保证未来表现。
sentences.question: Why did you choose that cross-validation scheme?

sentences.en: Nested validation separates parameter tuning from the outer performance evaluation.
sentences.zh: 嵌套验证将参数调优与外层性能评估分开。
sentences.note: separate A from B 表示分离两项工作；outer 指嵌套结构中的外层。
sentences.question: What role does the inner validation loop serve?

sentences.en: Feature selection belongs inside the training process for each split.
sentences.zh: 每次数据划分中的特征选择都应在训练流程内部完成。
sentences.note: belongs inside 表示应归入某个范围；for each split 强调要对每次划分分别执行。
sentences.question: Where does feature selection occur in your validation procedure?

sentences.en: A simple baseline helps establish whether added complexity is useful.
sentences.zh: 简单的基线模型有助于判断增加复杂度是否有用。
sentences.note: whether 引出待回答的问题；added complexity 指更复杂模型带来的额外复杂度。
sentences.question: Which baseline would provide a fair comparison for your model?

sentences.en: Class imbalance can make overall accuracy a misleading summary.
sentences.zh: 类别不平衡可能使总体准确率成为具有误导性的概括。
sentences.note: make A B 使用名词作宾语补足语；overall 限定这里指总体准确率。
sentences.question: Which metric would complement accuracy for an imbalanced dataset?

sentences.en: Precision depends on prevalence as well as model performance.
sentences.zh: 精确率既取决于模型表现，也取决于阳性比例。
sentences.note: depend on 表示取决于；as well as 并列两个因素。分类任务中的 precision 指精确率。
sentences.question: Why might precision change in a different population?

sentences.en: Recall measures the proportion of actual positives identified by the model.
sentences.zh: 召回率衡量模型识别出的阳性占实际阳性的比例。
sentences.note: the proportion of 明确这里衡量比例；actual positives 是分母，identified by the model 限定其中被识别的部分。
sentences.question: When is missing a positive case especially costly?

sentences.en: Choosing a decision threshold requires considering the costs of different errors.
sentences.zh: 选择决策阈值需要考虑不同错误的代价。
sentences.note: Choosing 加名词构成动名词主语；requires considering 表示决策时需要考虑的因素，不预设阈值已正确反映代价。
sentences.question: How would the intended application affect your decision threshold?

sentences.en: Calibration compares predicted probabilities with observed frequencies of the outcome.
sentences.zh: 校准比较预测概率与实际观测到的结局频率。
sentences.note: compare A with B 用来介绍比较对象；probabilities 与 frequencies 区分预测值和观测频率。
sentences.question: Why does probability calibration matter for decision making?

sentences.en: Good discrimination does not guarantee that predicted probabilities are calibrated.
sentences.zh: 良好的区分能力并不保证预测概率经过良好校准。
sentences.note: does not guarantee 后接 that 从句；discrimination 与 calibration 是不同的性能维度。
sentences.question: How would you distinguish discrimination from calibration?

chunks.zh: 预测概率经过良好校准

sentences.en: External validation examines performance in data collected outside the development setting.
sentences.zh: 外部验证考察模型在开发环境之外收集的数据上的表现。
sentences.note: collected 是过去分词，修饰 data；outside 明确与开发环境之间的区分。
sentences.question: What makes a validation dataset external to your development data?

sentences.en: Distribution shifts can weaken performance when the deployment population changes.
sentences.zh: 部署人群发生变化时，分布偏移可能削弱模型表现。
sentences.note: when 引导情境从句；can weaken 表示可能影响，不能据此认定所有偏移都有相同后果。
sentences.question: Which population changes could affect your model after deployment?

chunks.zh: 当部署人群发生变化时

sentences.en: Feature importance describes model behavior rather than proving a biological mechanism.
sentences.zh: 特征重要性描述模型的行为，并不能证明生物学机制。
sentences.note: rather than proving 对照两种解释；model behavior 将重要性限定在模型层面。
sentences.question: How would you present an important feature without making a causal claim?

sentences.en: Correlated features can share predictive information and complicate importance rankings.
sentences.zh: 相关特征可能共享预测信息，使重要性排序更复杂。
sentences.note: share 和 complicate 是共用 can 的并列谓语；rankings 指特征的相对排序。
sentences.question: How might correlated features affect your interpretation of importance?

sentences.en: We should report performance uncertainty alongside the chosen evaluation metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们应在报告所选评估指标的同时，报告性能的不确定性。
sentences.note: alongside 表示共同呈现；chosen evaluation metrics 提醒读者指标经过选择且需要说明。
sentences.question: How would you communicate uncertainty in model performance?

sentences.en: A reproducible project records how each output was created.
sentences.zh: 可复现的项目会记录每项输出是如何生成的。
sentences.note: how 引导宾语从句；was created 使用被动语态，将重点放在输出的生成过程上。
sentences.question: What information would let another researcher recreate your main figure?

sentences.en: Version control helps collaborators track changes to the analysis code.
sentences.zh: 版本控制帮助协作者追踪分析代码的变化。
sentences.note: help someone do 表示帮助完成某事；changes to 指针对某对象的修改。
sentences.question: Which changes would you describe in a useful commit message?

sentences.en: Each release should identify the code version used for analysis.
sentences.zh: 每次发布都应注明分析所使用的代码版本。
sentences.note: used for analysis 是过去分词短语，修饰 code version；identify 表示明确指出。
sentences.question: How would a reader find the exact code version behind your results?

sentences.en: An environment file lists the dependencies needed to run the workflow.
sentences.zh: 环境文件列出了运行该流程所需的依赖项。
sentences.note: needed to run 是过去分词短语，修饰 dependencies；environment file 指可保存的软件环境描述。
sentences.question: What dependencies belong in your environment file?

sentences.en: Pinned versions reduce unexpected changes caused by software updates.
sentences.zh: 固定版本可以减少软件更新带来的意外变化。
sentences.note: caused by 是过去分词短语，解释变化的来源；reduce 不表示完全消除兼容性问题。
sentences.question: When would you update a pinned software dependency?

sentences.en: A random seed helps reproduce stochastic steps under compatible conditions.
sentences.zh: 在兼容条件下，随机种子有助于复现随机步骤。
sentences.note: under compatible conditions 保留软件及硬件环境等条件；helps 不把种子等同于完整的复现保证。
sentences.question: Why might the same random seed still produce different outputs?

sentences.en: Raw inputs should remain unchanged throughout the analysis process.
sentences.zh: 在整个分析过程中，原始输入应保持不变。
sentences.note: remain unchanged 表示保持原状；throughout 强调整个过程都应如此。
sentences.question: How do you distinguish original inputs from processed data?

sentences.en: Checksums help detect whether a file has changed during transfer.
sentences.zh: 校验和有助于发现文件是否在传输过程中发生变化。
sentences.note: whether 引出待确认的问题；has changed 使用现在完成时，关注传输后的文件状态。
sentences.question: When would you compare file checksums in your workflow?

sentences.en: Clear file names make intermediate results easier to locate.
sentences.zh: 清晰的文件名让中间结果更容易找到。
sentences.note: make something easier to do 表达改善操作体验；intermediate results 指非最终输出。
sentences.question: What information should an intermediate file name convey?

sentences.en: Relative paths make a project easier to move between computers.
sentences.zh: 相对路径让项目更容易在不同电脑之间迁移。
sentences.note: easier to move 表示更易迁移；between computers 说明迁移的环境范围。
sentences.question: Which absolute paths would you replace before sharing your project?

sentences.en: Configuration files separate adjustable settings from the core analysis logic.
sentences.zh: 配置文件将可调整的设置与核心分析逻辑分开。
sentences.note: separate A from B 表示分离两类内容；adjustable 表示允许按任务调整。
sentences.question: Which settings should a collaborator change without editing the code?

sentences.en: Execution logs help explain where a workflow stopped unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 运行日志有助于说明流程在什么位置意外停止。
sentences.note: where 引导宾语从句，定位停止位置；unexpectedly 修饰 stopped。
sentences.question: Which log message would help you diagnose a failed run?

sentences.en: Cached outputs must be refreshed when their relevant inputs change.
sentences.zh: 相关输入变化时，必须刷新缓存的输出。
sentences.note: must be refreshed 使用被动语态；relevant inputs 明确只需关注影响该输出的输入。
sentences.question: How would you know that a cached result is outdated?

sentences.en: A small test dataset can reveal broken steps quickly.
sentences.zh: 小型测试数据集能够帮助快速发现失效的步骤。
sentences.note: can reveal 表示发现问题的能力；quickly 修饰 reveal，强调排查速度。
sentences.question: What should a useful test dataset cover?

sentences.en: Documentation should explain both expected inputs and important failure conditions.
sentences.zh: 文档应同时说明预期输入和重要的失败条件。
sentences.note: both A and B 并列两项内容；failure conditions 指可能导致流程无法完成的条件。
sentences.question: Which failure condition would you document for a new user?

sentences.en: A data dictionary defines variables, units, and allowed values clearly.
sentences.zh: 数据字典清楚定义变量、单位及允许的取值。
sentences.note: defines 后接并列宾语；allowed values 指合法类别或数值范围。
sentences.question: Which variable in your dataset most needs a clear definition?

chunks.zh: 变量、单位及允许的取值

sentences.en: Shared examples should avoid exposing private identifiers or access credentials.
sentences.zh: 共享示例应避免泄露私人标识信息或访问凭据。
sentences.note: avoid 后接动名词 exposing；or 连接两类需要保护的信息。
sentences.question: What information would you remove before sharing an example?

sentences.en: Access restrictions should follow the consent terms governing each dataset.
sentences.zh: 访问限制应遵循每个数据集所适用的知情同意条款。
sentences.note: governing each dataset 是现在分词短语，修饰 consent terms；follow 表示遵循。
sentences.question: How would you explain a data access restriction to a collaborator?

sentences.en: A license tells others how they may reuse shared code.
sentences.zh: 许可证说明他人可以如何重用共享代码。
sentences.note: tell someone how 引出操作方式；may 在这里表示许可，而非可能性。
sentences.question: Which reuse permissions should your code license explain?

chunks.en: how they may reuse shared code
chunks.zh: 可以如何重用共享代码

sentences.en: Independent reruns can uncover assumptions missing from the written instructions.
sentences.zh: 由他人独立重新运行，有助于发现书面说明遗漏的前提条件。
sentences.note: missing from 是后置修饰语，修饰 assumptions；can uncover 表示可能发现。
sentences.question: What would you ask a colleague to check during an independent rerun?

lessons.title: 微生物生态与环境研究
lessons.description: 60 句原创教学表达：1–20 微生物生态，21–40 土壤与环境，41–60 统计解释。练习描述群落差异、环境关联及不确定性；表达模板中的研究情境请替换为真实项目。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: Our research question concerns microbial diversity across contrasting habitats.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究问题涉及不同生境之间的微生物多样性。
sentences.note: concern 在此作及物动词，直接接研究主题；across 表示跨生境比较。
sentences.question: Which habitats would you compare in your own project?

chunks.zh: 在差异明显的生境之间

sentences.en: Species richness counts the species detected within a defined sample.
sentences.zh: 物种丰富度统计一个界定明确的样本中检测到的物种数。
sentences.note: detected 是过去分词，后置修饰 species；明确检测范围比笼统说物种总数更准确。
sentences.question: How would you distinguish richness from other diversity measures?

chunks.zh: 在一个界定明确的样本中

sentences.en: Evenness describes how evenly abundances are distributed among community members.
sentences.zh: 均匀度描述丰度在群落成员之间分布的均匀程度。
sentences.note: how evenly 引导宾语从句；among 用于多个群落成员之间。
sentences.question: What would a highly uneven community look like?

sentences.en: Beta diversity describes differences in community composition between samples.
sentences.zh: 贝塔多样性描述样本之间群落组成的差异。
sentences.note: differences in 指明差异体现在哪个方面；between samples 指明比较单位。
sentences.question: Which beta diversity measure fits your research question?

sentences.en: A relative abundance increase does not necessarily indicate absolute population growth.
sentences.zh: 相对丰度升高并不一定意味着种群绝对数量增长。
sentences.note: does not necessarily indicate 表示证据不足以必然推出结论；保留 necessarily 的限定。
sentences.question: What additional measurement could help interpret relative abundance?

sentences.en: Sequencing depth can affect our ability to detect rare taxa.
sentences.zh: 测序深度可能影响我们检测稀有分类单元的能力。
sentences.note: can affect 表示可能影响；ability to 后接动词原形说明具体能力。
sentences.question: How would you discuss the detection of rare taxa?

sentences.en: Before comparing groups, we should examine differences in sample quality.
sentences.zh: 在比较分组之前，我们应检查样本质量是否存在差异。
sentences.note: Before 加动名词构成时间状语；should examine 用于提出分析顺序。
sentences.question: Which sample quality checks matter for your dataset?

sentences.en: Environmental conditions may be associated with shifts in community composition.
sentences.zh: 环境条件可能与群落组成的变化有关。
sentences.note: be associated with 适用于描述关联；shifts in 后接发生变化的特征。
sentences.question: Which environmental variable would you examine first, and why?

sentences.en: A shared environmental response can produce correlations between noninteracting taxa.
sentences.zh: 共同的环境响应可能使没有直接相互作用的分类单元呈现相关性。
sentences.note: can produce 表示一种可能机制；noninteracting 明确指不存在直接相互作用。
sentences.question: How might a shared environmental response influence a network?

chunks.zh: 在没有直接相互作用的分类单元之间

sentences.en: Association network edges represent statistical associations, not necessarily direct biological interactions.
sentences.zh: 关联网络的连边表示统计关联，不一定代表直接的生物相互作用。
sentences.note: not necessarily 保留推断强度；direct 区分直接作用与间接关联。
sentences.question: What would you say when someone calls every edge an interaction?

chunks.zh: 不一定是直接的生物相互作用

sentences.en: A highly connected taxon may deserve further investigation as a candidate.
sentences.zh: 连接度较高的分类单元可能值得作为候选对象进一步研究。
sentences.note: may deserve further investigation 表达研究优先级；candidate 表明仍处于候选阶段。
sentences.question: How would you prioritize a candidate identified from a network?

chunks.zh: 连接度较高的分类单元

sentences.en: Functional potential does not establish which processes are active in situ.
sentences.zh: 功能潜力并不能确定哪些过程正在原位环境中活跃进行。
sentences.note: does not establish 区分可编码的潜力与实际活动；which 引导宾语从句。
sentences.question: How would you explain the difference between potential and activity?

sentences.en: We can describe a community pattern without claiming a causal mechanism.
sentences.zh: 我们可以描述群落模式，而不声称已经确定因果机制。
sentences.note: without 加动名词说明未随之作出的推断；a pattern 与 a mechanism 表达不同层级。
sentences.question: Describe one pattern you could report before explaining its mechanism.

chunks.zh: 而不声称已经确定因果机制

sentences.en: Seasonal variation may complicate comparisons between samples collected at different times.
sentences.zh: 季节变化可能使不同时间采集样本之间的比较更复杂。
sentences.note: collected at different times 后置修饰 samples；may complicate 用于说明比较中的潜在影响。
sentences.question: How would you account for sampling time in your interpretation?

chunks.en: between samples collected at different times.
chunks.zh: 在不同时间采集的样本之间

sentences.en: The analysis should reflect the sampling design and the intended ecological comparison.
sentences.zh: 分析应体现采样设计和预期进行的生态学比较。
sentences.note: reflect 在方法讨论中表示与设计相符；intended 强调事先明确的目标。
sentences.question: Which part of your sampling design shapes your analysis?

chunks.zh: 以及预期的生态学比较

sentences.en: Spatial clustering can reduce the independent information provided by nearby samples.
sentences.zh: 空间聚集可能减少相邻样本所提供的独立信息。
sentences.note: provided by 是过去分词短语，修饰 information；can 表示依赖具体空间结构的可能性。
sentences.question: Why might nearby samples provide overlapping information?

sentences.en: Taxonomic labels can change when reference databases are updated.
sentences.zh: 参考数据库更新时，分类标签可能发生变化。
sentences.note: when 引导时间或条件背景；are updated 使用被动语态，重点在数据库版本变化。
sentences.question: How would you document the reference database used?

sentences.en: An undetected organism is not necessarily absent from the original sample.
sentences.zh: 某种生物未被检测到，并不一定意味着它在原始样本中不存在。
sentences.note: undetected 与 absent 区分检测结果和真实存在状态；not necessarily 避免绝对化。
sentences.question: What could explain a failure to detect an organism?

sentences.en: We should report the uncertainty around estimated differences between communities.
sentences.zh: 我们应报告群落间估计差异的不确定性。
sentences.note: uncertainty around 表示估计值周围的不确定范围；estimated 提醒听者这是估计结果。
sentences.question: How would you communicate uncertainty in a community comparison?

sentences.en: A useful ecological interpretation connects the observed pattern to a testable question.
sentences.zh: 有用的生态学解释会把观测模式与可检验的问题联系起来。
sentences.note: connect A to B 连接证据与后续问题；testable 强调问题可以接受检验。
sentences.question: Turn an ecological pattern into a testable follow-up question.

sentences.en: This project asks how soil properties vary across the study area.
sentences.zh: 本项目探讨土壤性质如何在研究区域内变化。
sentences.note: asks how 将项目目标表述为研究问题；across the study area 明确空间范围。
sentences.question: Which soil property is central to your research question?

sentences.en: Soil carbon concentration and carbon stock describe different quantities.
sentences.zh: 土壤碳浓度与碳储量描述的是不同的量。
sentences.note: concentration 与 stock 分别对应浓度和储量；并列主语使用复数谓语 describe。
sentences.question: How would you distinguish carbon concentration from carbon stock?

chunks.en: Soil carbon concentration and carbon stock

sentences.en: Estimating a carbon stock requires information beyond carbon concentration alone.
sentences.zh: 估计碳储量需要碳浓度以外的信息。
sentences.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用 requires；beyond...alone 强调单一指标不够。
sentences.question: What additional information would a carbon stock estimate require?

sentences.en: Sampling depth should be reported when comparing soil carbon measurements.
sentences.zh: 比较土壤碳测量值时，应报告采样深度。
sentences.note: should be reported 是情态动词加被动结构；when comparing 引出适用情境。
sentences.question: How would different sampling depths affect the comparison?

sentences.en: Soil moisture can influence the interpretation of biological measurements.
sentences.zh: 土壤含水状况可能影响对生物学测量结果的解释。
sentences.note: influence 直接接宾语；the interpretation of 指对何种结果进行解释。
sentences.question: Why would you record soil moisture alongside biological measurements?

sentences.en: A temperature gradient may coincide with changes in vegetation and soil texture.
sentences.zh: 温度梯度可能同时伴随植被和土壤质地的变化。
sentences.note: coincide with 表示共同出现，不直接指定因果方向。
sentences.question: Which variables might change together along your environmental gradient?

chunks.zh: 植被与土壤质地方面的

sentences.en: Correlated environmental variables can make individual effects difficult to distinguish.
sentences.zh: 彼此相关的环境变量可能使各自的效应难以区分。
sentences.note: make 加宾语和形容词补语；difficult to distinguish 说明分析难点。
sentences.question: How would you explain correlated predictors to a collaborator?

sentences.en: The study design should specify the spatial scale of each comparison.
sentences.zh: 研究设计应明确每项比较的空间尺度。
sentences.note: specify 表示给出明确界定；of each comparison 将尺度对应到具体比较。
sentences.question: At what spatial scale does your main comparison operate?

sentences.en: Nearby sampling locations may share environmental features that influence measured responses.
sentences.zh: 邻近采样地点可能具有共同的环境特征，从而影响测量到的响应。
sentences.note: that 引导定语从句修饰 features；may share 保留对具体地点的条件性判断。
sentences.question: Which shared features might connect nearby sampling locations?

sentences.en: Replicate measurements within one plot do not automatically provide independent site replication.
sentences.zh: 同一样地内的重复测量并不自动构成独立的地点重复。
sentences.note: do not automatically 区分测量重复与设计层面的独立重复；within 明确嵌套关系。
sentences.question: What is the independent sampling unit in your study?

sentences.en: We should distinguish spatial contrasts from changes measured through time.
sentences.zh: 我们应区分空间对比和随时间测得的变化。
sentences.note: distinguish A from B 明确区分两种证据；through time 表示沿时间展开。
sentences.question: Why might a spatial contrast differ from a temporal change?

sentences.en: A single sampling campaign cannot capture every aspect of seasonal variability.
sentences.zh: 一次采样调查无法涵盖季节变异的所有方面。
sentences.note: cannot capture every aspect 指覆盖范围有限；campaign 在科研语境中可指集中调查。
sentences.question: Which seasonal changes could a single survey miss?

sentences.en: Carbon measurements should be interpreted alongside information about soil conditions.
sentences.zh: 解释碳测量结果时，应结合土壤条件的信息。
sentences.note: alongside information about 表示将背景信息纳入解释，而非单独看一个数值。
sentences.question: Which soil conditions would help interpret your carbon measurements?

sentences.en: The observed association may reflect several environmental processes acting together.
sentences.zh: 观测到的关联可能反映多种环境过程的共同作用。
sentences.note: acting together 是现在分词短语，修饰 processes；may reflect 保留多种解释。
sentences.question: What alternative processes could explain the same association?

sentences.en: A map helps readers understand the sampling coverage across the landscape.
sentences.zh: 地图帮助读者理解景观中的采样覆盖范围。
sentences.note: help someone do 可省略 to；coverage 强调采样覆盖了哪些区域。
sentences.question: What should your sampling map make immediately clear?

sentences.en: Unsampled areas may differ from the locations included in the analysis.
sentences.zh: 未采样区域可能不同于纳入分析的地点。
sentences.note: differ from 用于比较；included in 为过去分词短语，限定分析范围。
sentences.question: How would you describe the limits of your geographic coverage?

sentences.en: Our conclusions should match the environmental range represented by the samples.
sentences.zh: 我们的结论应与样本代表的环境范围相匹配。
sentences.note: match 强调结论范围与数据范围一致；represented by 说明范围来自哪些样本。
sentences.question: Which environments are represented poorly in your dataset?

sentences.en: Historical land use may help explain present differences between sampling sites.
sentences.zh: 历史土地利用可能有助于解释采样地点之间当前的差异。
sentences.note: may help explain 表示可能贡献解释，而非唯一原因；present 此处作形容词。
sentences.question: What historical information would be useful for interpreting your sites?

sentences.en: Reporting measurement units makes soil datasets easier to compare and reuse.
sentences.zh: 报告测量单位会使土壤数据集更便于比较和复用。
sentences.note: 动名词 Reporting 作主语；make something easier to do 表达提高可用性。
sentences.question: Which unit conversions would you check before combining datasets?

sentences.en: A stronger follow-up study would address the most important uncertainty in our interpretation.
sentences.zh: 更有针对性的后续研究应处理当前解释中最重要的不确定性。
sentences.note: would address 用于讨论拟议研究；in our interpretation 明确不确定性所在。
sentences.question: Which uncertainty would you prioritize in a follow-up study?

chunks.zh: 更有针对性的后续研究

sentences.en: An effect estimate describes the magnitude of a measured difference.
sentences.zh: 效应估计用于描述所测差异的大小。
sentences.note: the magnitude of 表示某种差异或效应的大小；estimate 强调它是估计值。
sentences.question: Which effect estimate best answers your research question?

sentences.en: Uncertainty intervals help readers judge the precision of an estimate.
sentences.zh: 不确定性区间有助于读者判断估计的精确程度。
sentences.note: help readers judge 表达工具的用途；precision 关注估计的不确定程度，与 accuracy 含义不同。
sentences.question: How would you explain a wide uncertainty interval?

sentences.en: A small p value does not measure practical importance.
sentences.zh: 较小的 p 值并不能衡量实际重要性。
sentences.note: does not measure 用明确的否定动词说明指标的含义；practical importance 需要结合效应及应用背景判断。
sentences.question: What else would you report alongside a p value?

sentences.en: A nonsignificant result does not establish that the effect is absent.
sentences.zh: 统计学不显著的结果并不能证明效应不存在。
sentences.note: does not establish 后接 that 从句；absent 表示不存在，语气强于尚未检出。
sentences.question: How would you discuss an inconclusive statistical result?

sentences.en: Multiple comparisons increase the chance of at least one false positive.
sentences.zh: 多重比较会增加至少出现一个假阳性的概率。
sentences.note: the chance of 后接名词短语；at least one 清楚界定这里讨论的是至少一次错误。
sentences.question: Why should readers know how many comparisons were performed?

chunks.en: of at least one false positive
chunks.zh: 至少出现一个假阳性的

sentences.en: The correction method should match the intended family of tests.
sentences.zh: 校正方法应与预先界定的检验家族相匹配。
sentences.note: match 表示匹配；family of tests 指一组需要共同考虑多重性的问题。
sentences.question: How would you define the family of tests?

sentences.en: Correlation alone cannot establish a causal relationship between variables.
sentences.zh: 仅凭相关性无法确立变量之间的因果关系。
sentences.note: alone 强调证据仅限于相关性；cannot establish 表示该证据不足以确立因果。
sentences.question: What additional evidence would strengthen a causal explanation?

sentences.en: Confounding can produce an association without a direct causal effect.
sentences.zh: 混杂可以在没有直接因果效应时产生关联。
sentences.note: without 后接名词短语，明确一种关联可能出现的条件；can 表示可能机制。
sentences.question: Can you describe a plausible confounder in your study?

chunks.zh: 在没有直接因果效应时

sentences.en: Adjustment reduces some biases only when its assumptions are appropriate.
sentences.zh: 调整只有在相关假设恰当时，才能减少某些偏倚。
sentences.note: only when 给出必要条件；some biases 明确调整不必然消除所有偏倚。
sentences.question: Which assumptions support your adjustment strategy?

chunks.en: only when its assumptions are appropriate

sentences.en: The model estimates an association conditional on the included covariates.
sentences.zh: 该模型估计的是给定所纳入协变量条件下的关联。
sentences.note: conditional on 表示以某些变量为条件；included 表示实际纳入模型的变量。
sentences.question: How would you describe the covariates in your model?

chunks.zh: 以所纳入的协变量为条件的

sentences.en: Outliers deserve investigation before we decide whether to exclude them.
sentences.zh: 在决定是否排除离群值之前，应先进行核查。
sentences.note: deserve investigation 表示值得核查；whether to exclude them 表示尚待作出的决定。
sentences.question: What evidence would justify excluding an unusual observation?

sentences.en: Missing data can change both precision and the risk of bias.
sentences.zh: 缺失数据可能同时改变精确程度和偏倚风险。
sentences.note: both A and B 将两个影响并列；can change 保留对缺失机制及分析方法的依赖。
sentences.question: What would you report about missing data?

sentences.en: The missingness mechanism matters when choosing how to handle incomplete records.
sentences.zh: 选择如何处理不完整记录时，缺失机制十分重要。
sentences.note: matters 表示具有实质影响；when choosing 引出作出决策的情境。
sentences.question: How could different missingness mechanisms affect your analysis?

sentences.en: Subgroup differences require a direct comparison, not separate significance labels.
sentences.zh: 判断亚组之间是否有差异，需要直接比较，不能只看各自的显著性标签。
sentences.note: require 表示所需证据；separate significance labels 指分别显著或不显著的判断。
sentences.question: How would you test whether effects differ between subgroups?

sentences.en: An interaction term allows an association to vary across conditions.
sentences.zh: 交互项允许关联随条件变化。
sentences.note: allow something to do 表示允许某种变化；交互项在模型中表达这种变化，是否有统计证据还需检验。
sentences.question: How would you explain an interaction to a collaborator?

sentences.en: A larger sample may improve precision without removing systematic bias.
sentences.zh: 更大的样本可能提高精确程度，但未必消除系统性偏倚。
sentences.note: may improve 表示可能改善；without removing 区分精确程度和系统性偏倚这两个问题。
sentences.question: Which problems cannot be solved by increasing sample size?

chunks.zh: 却没有消除系统性偏倚

sentences.en: Model assumptions should be checked against the observed data structure.
sentences.zh: 应结合实际观测到的数据结构检查模型假设。
sentences.note: should be checked 使用被动语态；against 表示以数据结构为对照来核查。
sentences.question: Which model assumption is most relevant to your data?

chunks.zh: 对照观测到的数据结构

sentences.en: Exploratory findings can guide questions for a future confirmatory study.
sentences.zh: 探索性发现可以为未来的验证性研究提供问题线索。
sentences.note: guide questions for 表示引导后续研究问题；exploratory 和 confirmatory 区分研究目的。
sentences.question: Which exploratory finding would you prioritize for confirmation?

sentences.en: I report the estimated direction alongside its uncertainty interval.
sentences.zh: 我会同时报告估计效应的方向及其不确定性区间。
sentences.note: alongside 表示同时呈现；estimated direction 提醒方向来自估计，需结合区间理解。
sentences.question: How would you summarize an estimate with substantial uncertainty?

sentences.en: The conclusion should reflect the strength and scope of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 结论应与证据的强度及适用范围相一致。
sentences.note: the strength and scope of 并列说明证据的两个维度；should reflect 用于提出表述原则。
sentences.question: Which word would you change to make a conclusion more accurate?

lessons.title: 论文精读与学术讨论
lessons.description: 60 句原创教学表达：1–20 论文阅读，21–40 讲图与研究限制，41–60 合作与组会。练习提炼问题、解释结果图、提出建设性问题与商定下一步；并非具体论文的原文摘录。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: Before reading the methods, I identify the main research question.
sentences.zh: 阅读方法之前，我先识别论文的核心研究问题。
sentences.note: Before 加动名词短语交代阅读顺序；identify 强调找准问题。
sentences.question: State the central question of a paper you recently read.

sentences.en: The abstract provides an overview, but important details require closer reading.
sentences.zh: 摘要提供概览，但重要细节需要进一步仔细阅读。
sentences.note: but 连接两项信息；closer reading 指比摘要浏览更细致的阅读。
sentences.question: Which details would you verify beyond the abstract?

sentences.en: A clear hypothesis specifies a relationship that the study can evaluate.
sentences.zh: 清晰的假设明确指出研究能够评估的一种关系。
sentences.note: that 引导定语从句，限定 relationship；evaluate 比 prove 更适合描述检验过程。
sentences.question: How would you restate the authors’ hypothesis in your own words?

sentences.en: The introduction should explain why the research gap matters.
sentences.zh: 引言应说明这一研究空白为什么重要。
sentences.note: why 引导宾语从句，连接知识缺口与研究价值；matters 作动词表示重要。
sentences.question: Why does the gap addressed in your chosen paper matter?

sentences.en: I look for the comparison that directly addresses the stated question.
sentences.zh: 我会寻找直接回应所提出问题的那项比较。
sentences.note: look for 表示有目的地查找；stated 指论文明确提出的，而非读者推测的问题。
sentences.question: Which comparison most directly answers the research question?

sentences.en: The methods section should define the study population and sampling strategy.
sentences.zh: 方法部分应界定研究总体和采样策略。
sentences.note: define 用于明确研究对象与选择方法；并列名词结构使概括更紧凑。
sentences.question: Who or what was sampled, and how were samples selected?

sentences.en: An observational design requires careful consideration of potential confounding.
sentences.zh: 观察性设计需要认真考虑潜在混杂。
sentences.note: consideration of 是名词搭配；potential 表明混杂因素需要结合具体设计判断。
sentences.question: Which potential confounder would you examine in this study?

sentences.en: The control group determines which comparison the experiment can support.
sentences.zh: 对照组决定实验能够支持哪一种比较。
sentences.note: which comparison 引导宾语从句；support 在此表示研究设计可以支撑的比较。
sentences.question: What does the chosen control group allow the authors to compare?

sentences.en: I check whether the analysis matches the original sampling structure.
sentences.zh: 我会核查分析是否与原始采样结构匹配。
sentences.note: whether 引导需要核查的判断；sampling structure 包含分组、配对或嵌套等结构。
sentences.question: Which feature of the sampling structure should the analysis preserve?

sentences.en: The number of measurements may exceed the number of independent samples.
sentences.zh: 测量次数可能超过独立样本数量。
sentences.note: the number of 后面的谓语按 number 的单数形式处理；may exceed 提醒区分两种计数。
sentences.question: How many independent units support the central comparison?

sentences.en: Exclusion criteria can influence which populations the findings apply to.
sentences.zh: 排除标准可能影响研究结果能够适用于哪些总体。
sentences.note: apply to 表示适用范围；疑问词引导的从句中保留陈述语序。
sentences.question: How might the exclusion criteria limit the scope of the findings?

sentences.en: Missing observations may affect the conclusions depending on why they are missing.
sentences.zh: 缺失观测可能影响结论，具体取决于其缺失原因。
sentences.note: depending on 引出条件；why they are missing 将缺失机制纳入讨论。
sentences.question: What information would help you assess the missing observations?

chunks.en: depending on why they are missing.
chunks.zh: 取决于它们缺失的原因

sentences.en: I separate the reported results from the authors’ proposed explanations.
sentences.zh: 我会区分文中报告的结果和作者提出的解释。
sentences.note: separate A from B 用于区分证据与解释；proposed 表示解释是作者提出的。
sentences.question: Give one reported result and one proposed explanation from a paper.

sentences.en: A statistically significant result does not establish practical importance by itself.
sentences.zh: 统计学显著的结果本身并不能确定其实际重要性。
sentences.note: by itself 强调仅凭这一信息不够；practical importance 与统计显著性关注不同问题。
sentences.question: What else would you examine before calling an effect important?

sentences.en: An effect estimate is easier to interpret with its uncertainty and measurement scale.
sentences.zh: 结合不确定性和测量尺度，效应估计值更容易理解。
sentences.note: easier to interpret 为比较级加不定式；with 指明理解所需的配套信息。
sentences.question: Which scale is used for the effect estimate in this paper?

sentences.en: The supplementary materials may contain details needed to assess reproducibility.
sentences.zh: 补充材料可能包含评估可复现性所需的细节。
sentences.note: needed to assess 是过去分词短语，后置修饰 details；may contain 提醒主动查阅。
sentences.question: Which supplementary detail would you inspect before reproducing an analysis?

sentences.en: A citation should support the specific claim made in the text.
sentences.zh: 引用应支持正文中提出的具体论断。
sentences.note: made in the text 为过去分词定语；specific claim 强调逐项核对引用用途。
sentences.question: How would you check whether a citation supports a particular claim?

sentences.en: I compare the headline conclusion with the evidence actually presented.
sentences.zh: 我会比较最醒目的结论与论文实际展示的证据。
sentences.note: compare A with B 将结论与证据对照；actually presented 限定为文中确实展示的信息。
sentences.question: Does the headline conclusion match the evidence you can identify?

sentences.en: A useful critique explains how a limitation could change the interpretation.
sentences.zh: 有用的评议会说明某项局限可能如何改变解释。
sentences.note: could change 把局限与实际推断影响联系起来；how 引出作用方式。
sentences.question: Which limitation would most affect your interpretation of this paper?

sentences.en: After reading, I summarize one finding and one unresolved question.
sentences.zh: 读完之后，我会概括一项发现和一个尚未解决的问题。
sentences.note: one...and one... 将总结控制在可复述的两个重点；unresolved 表示仍待回答。
sentences.question: What finding and unresolved question would you share at journal club?

chunks.zh: 与一个尚未解决的问题

sentences.en: Before interpreting the pattern, I check the axis labels and units.
sentences.zh: 解释图中模式之前，我先查看坐标轴标签和单位。
sentences.note: Before interpreting 引出先行步骤；labels and units 提醒同时看变量名称和尺度。
sentences.question: What do the two axes represent in your chosen figure?

sentences.en: The legend should explain the symbols, colors, and groups shown in the figure.
sentences.zh: 图例应说明图中展示的符号、颜色和分组。
sentences.note: shown in the figure 是过去分词短语；并列宾语有助于逐项检查图例。
sentences.question: Which visual element would be unclear without the legend?

sentences.en: Each point should correspond to a clearly defined observation or sampling unit.
sentences.zh: 每个点应对应一个定义明确的观测或采样单位。
sentences.note: correspond to 表示对应；observation 与 sampling unit 需要按图的实际含义区分。
sentences.question: What exactly does one point represent in your plot?

sentences.en: A logarithmic axis changes how numerical differences appear on the page.
sentences.zh: 对数坐标轴会改变数值差异在页面上的呈现方式。
sentences.note: how 引导宾语从句；changes how...appear 描述视觉映射方式的改变。
sentences.question: Why might the authors choose a logarithmic axis?

sentences.en: The caption should state what the error bars represent.
sentences.zh: 图注应注明误差线代表什么。
sentences.note: what 引导宾语从句；represent 要与实际使用的标准差、标准误或区间相对应。
sentences.question: What do the error bars represent in this figure?

sentences.en: Group averages can hide variation among the individual observations.
sentences.zh: 组均值可能掩盖各个观测值之间的变异。
sentences.note: can hide 表示汇总可能带来的信息损失；among 指多个观测值之间。
sentences.question: What additional display would reveal variation within each group?

sentences.en: Overlapping data points may obscure the density of observations.
sentences.zh: 重叠的数据点可能使观测值的密度难以辨认。
sentences.note: may obscure 描述视觉上的遮蔽；density of observations 指点在图中的聚集程度。
sentences.question: How could you make overlapping observations easier to see?

sentences.en: The direction of association should be described before discussing its possible explanation.
sentences.zh: 讨论可能解释之前，应先描述关联方向。
sentences.note: should be described 使用被动语态突出报告顺序；possible explanation 保留解释的假设性质。
sentences.question: Describe the direction of an association without explaining its cause.

sentences.en: The apparent trend may depend on a small number of influential observations.
sentences.zh: 表面上呈现的趋势可能取决于少数影响较大的观测值。
sentences.note: depend on 为固定搭配；influential 指对估计或趋势影响较大的点。
sentences.question: How would you examine whether a few observations drive the trend?

sentences.en: A wide interval indicates substantial uncertainty under the stated analysis assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在所声明的分析假设下，较宽的区间表明较大的不确定性。
sentences.note: under the stated assumptions 将解释限定在所采用的方法条件内；substantial 表示程度较大。
sentences.question: How would you communicate a wide uncertainty interval to a general audience?

chunks.zh: 在所声明的分析假设下

sentences.en: The figure alone cannot establish the causal direction between these variables.
sentences.zh: 单凭这张图无法确定这些变量之间的因果方向。
sentences.note: alone 强调证据来源有限；causal direction 指哪一个变量影响另一个。
sentences.question: What other evidence would help investigate the causal direction?

sentences.en: A nonsignificant result does not demonstrate the complete absence of an effect.
sentences.zh: 不显著的结果并不证明完全不存在效应。
sentences.note: does not demonstrate 区分未检出证据和已经证实不存在；absence of 为常用搭配。
sentences.question: How would you describe a nonsignificant result without overstating it?

sentences.en: The confidence interval provides information about the precision of the estimate.
sentences.zh: 置信区间提供了关于估计精度的信息。
sentences.note: information about 后接所说明的方面；precision 与效应大小是不同概念。
sentences.question: What does the interval width tell you about precision?

sentences.en: A sensitivity analysis can show whether conclusions depend on particular choices.
sentences.zh: 敏感性分析可以显示结论是否依赖特定的分析选择。
sentences.note: whether 引导需要考察的问题；depend on 用于说明结论对选择的依赖。
sentences.question: Which analysis choice would you vary in a sensitivity analysis?

sentences.en: Consistency across analyses can strengthen confidence in a specific interpretation.
sentences.zh: 不同分析间的一致性可以增强对某一具体解释的信心。
sentences.note: strengthen confidence in 表达增强支持程度；specific 避免把一致性扩展为所有解释都成立。
sentences.question: Which analyses would provide meaningfully different checks of your conclusion?

sentences.en: A limitation is most informative when its consequences are explained clearly.
sentences.zh: 说明清楚后果时，对局限的讨论最有信息价值。
sentences.note: when 引出有用讨论的条件；consequences 要具体对应结果、范围或解释。
sentences.question: Explain how one limitation affects the conclusion, rather than only naming it.

sentences.en: The findings may not generalize beyond the conditions represented in this study.
sentences.zh: 这些发现可能无法推广到本研究涵盖条件之外。
sentences.note: generalize beyond 表示向研究范围外推广；may not 保留对具体情境的判断。
sentences.question: Which new setting would be most different from the study conditions?

sentences.en: We can acknowledge uncertainty while explaining what the evidence supports.
sentences.zh: 我们可以承认不确定性，同时说明证据支持什么。
sentences.note: while 加动名词连接同时进行的两项沟通任务；supports 指证据实际支撑的范围。
sentences.question: How would you explain both the main evidence and its uncertainty?

sentences.en: The next experiment should distinguish between plausible explanations for this pattern.
sentences.zh: 下一项实验应能区分对这一模式的几种合理解释。
sentences.note: distinguish between 表示在多个解释之间作区分；plausible 指合理可信、仍有待检验。
sentences.question: What comparison could separate two plausible explanations for your result?

chunks.zh: 合理可信的解释之间的差异

sentences.en: My concluding sentence should connect the key result to the original question.
sentences.zh: 我的总结句应把关键结果与最初的研究问题联系起来。
sentences.note: connect A to B 使报告结尾回到研究目标；concluding sentence 指收束讨论的总结句。
sentences.question: Give a one-sentence conclusion that directly answers your original question.

sentences.en: Could we agree on the main goal for today's meeting?
sentences.zh: 我们能否先就今天会议的主要目标达成一致？
sentences.note: Could we… 用共同商量的语气提议；agree on 后接需要达成一致的事项。
sentences.question: What should your next project meeting accomplish?

sentences.en: I have added the main discussion points to our agenda.
sentences.zh: 我已将主要讨论事项加入议程。
sentences.note: have added 用现在完成时说明准备已完成；add A to B 表示把事项加入议程。
sentences.question: Which items would you include in a project meeting agenda?

sentences.en: Let us separate urgent decisions from topics that need further discussion.
sentences.zh: 我们先把紧急决策和需要进一步讨论的话题分开。
sentences.note: Let us… 提出共同采取的行动；separate A from B 可用于整理议题的优先级。
sentences.question: Which decision needs attention first in your current project?

chunks.zh: 需要进一步讨论的话题

sentences.en: I can prepare a short summary before our next meeting.
sentences.zh: 我可以在下次会议前准备一份简短总结。
sentences.note: can prepare 表示主动承担任务；before 明确交付的时间节点。
sentences.question: What would you summarize before meeting a potential collaborator?

sentences.en: Could you explain how this task fits the project timeline?
sentences.zh: 你能说明这项任务如何纳入项目时间安排吗？
sentences.note: how 引导宾语从句；fits the timeline 用于讨论任务与整体进度的关系。
sentences.question: How would you explain the timing of your next analysis task?

sentences.en: We should confirm who is responsible for each analysis step.
sentences.zh: 我们应确认每个分析步骤由谁负责。
sentences.note: who is responsible… 是嵌入问句，保持陈述语序；be responsible for 表示负责。
sentences.question: How would you clarify responsibilities in a shared analysis project?

sentences.en: I will share the draft once the figures are ready.
sentences.zh: 图准备好后，我会分享草稿。
sentences.note: once 在这里表示一旦；时间从句用 are ready，不需要使用 will。
sentences.question: What needs to be ready before you share your next draft?

sentences.en: Please let me know which section needs the most attention.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我哪一部分最需要重点修改。
sentences.note: let me know 用于请求反馈；which section needs… 以 section 为从句主语。
sentences.question: Which section of your current work would benefit most from feedback?

sentences.en: Your suggestion helps me see the problem from another perspective.
sentences.zh: 你的建议帮助我从另一个角度理解这个问题。
sentences.note: help someone do something 表示帮助某人做某事；from another perspective 引出新视角。
sentences.question: Can you describe feedback that changed how you approached a problem?

sentences.en: I agree with the goal, but I suggest a different approach.
sentences.zh: 我赞同这个目标，但建议采用另一种做法。
sentences.note: agree with the goal 先明确共同目标；suggest 后接名词短语，提出具体替代方法。
sentences.question: How would you propose another approach while maintaining a constructive tone?

sentences.en: Could we compare the advantages of these two options first?
sentences.zh: 我们可以先比较这两个选项的优点吗？
sentences.note: Could we compare… 是合作式提议；of these two options 修饰 advantages。
sentences.question: What criteria would you use to compare two analysis options?

sentences.en: I may have misunderstood the scope of the requested revision.
sentences.zh: 我可能误解了这次修改要求的范围。
sentences.note: may have misunderstood 表示对过去理解的可能性判断；scope 指工作范围。
sentences.question: How would you clarify an ambiguous revision request?

sentences.en: This change would require additional time for checking the results.
sentences.zh: 这一改动需要额外时间来核查结果。
sentences.note: would require 用于说明拟议改动的影响；for checking 表达额外时间的用途。
sentences.question: How would you explain a reasonable delay caused by additional checks?

sentences.en: Would it help if we divided this task into smaller steps?
sentences.zh: 如果把这项任务拆成更小的步骤，会有帮助吗？
sentences.note: Would it help if… 委婉提出建议；divided 采用过去式以配合假设语气。
sentences.question: How could you break a complex analysis task into manageable parts?

sentences.en: I would appreciate feedback on the clarity of this explanation.
sentences.zh: 我希望得到关于这段解释是否清楚的反馈。
sentences.note: I would appreciate… 比 I want 更适合礼貌请求；on the clarity 明确希望反馈的重点。
sentences.question: Which part of your project is hardest to explain clearly?

sentences.en: Let us record the decision so everyone has the same understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们把决定记录下来，以便大家保持一致的理解。
sentences.note: so 引出记录决定的目的；the same understanding 强调对行动事项的共同理解。
sentences.question: What details should a meeting record include to prevent confusion?

sentences.en: We can revisit this question after reviewing the new information.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在查看新信息之后重新讨论这个问题。
sentences.note: revisit 表示重新审视已讨论的问题；after reviewing 把讨论放在检查信息之后。
sentences.question: When would it be useful to reconsider a previous project decision?

sentences.en: Could we schedule a short follow-up meeting for next week?
sentences.zh: 我们可以安排下周进行一次简短的后续会议吗？
sentences.note: schedule 作动词表示安排时间；follow-up 作定语说明这是后续沟通。
sentences.question: What would you want to review in a follow-up meeting?

sentences.en: I will send a written summary of the agreed next steps.
sentences.zh: 我会发送一份书面总结，列出已商定的下一步行动。
sentences.note: written 是过去分词作定语；agreed next steps 指各方已商定的后续行动。
sentences.question: How would you summarize next steps after a productive meeting?

chunks.zh: 关于已商定的下一步行动

sentences.en: Thank you for explaining the reasoning behind your recommendation.
sentences.zh: 感谢你解释这项建议背后的理由。
sentences.note: thank someone for doing something 表达感谢；reasoning 强调推理过程，而不仅是结论。
sentences.question: How would you acknowledge useful feedback before explaining your next action?
